candidates.issues: Very accurate and natural. The first step is slightly wordy. "2 ملعقة" is used instead of "ملعقتان", a common recipe convention.
Accurate. "انثرهما" for drizzle is imprecise. "50 غرام" lacks the accusative ending. Minor stylistic points only.
Accurate, with clear sandwich assembly and drizzle as "خيوط رفيعة". "4 بيض كبير الحجم" is a bit awkward in the ingredients. Minor tanween omissions.
"باهت اللون" is an odd choice for pale. "ألصق الكيكتين" is literal. The sifting step omits "over the mixture". Otherwise uses good dual forms (ملعقتين).
The oven line copies the slash format. "ضع الكيك على حامل" before sandwiching is slightly confusing. "رشّهما" is vague for drizzle. "4 بيض كبير" is awkward.
"حفنة ملح" (a handful) mistranslates "pinch". "عود التنقيب" is wrong. "شرائح" (slices) is wrong for shards. "وفرش" and "اذب" are grammatical errors.
